notes: Fetch raw_base_url from another website. GitHub sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on raw files. pages_base_url is the same JSON copied into the docs site on deploy. null in a record means the source did not state that value.

files.title: Data catalog
files.description: This file. Lists every JSON file under data/ and the shape of each one.
files.schema_notes: schema_version, license, license_url, updated, raw_base_url, pages_base_url, notes, files[]. path, title, description, and schema_notes are strings.

files.title: Printer comparison
files.description: Consumer FDM printers with manufacturer specs. Unknown numbers are null.
files.schema_notes: schema_version, updated, currency, disclaimer, picks (beginners, multicolor, engineering, big_prints are arrays of printer id), printers[]. Each printer has id, brand, model, motion, price_usd, price_note, price_source_url, build_volume_mm ({x,y,z} or null), build_volume_note, enclosed, heated_chamber, chamber_max_c, max_nozzle_c, max_bed_c, multi_material (system, type, slots, max_slots, note), top_speed_mm_s, speed_note, best_for, skill_level, source_urls, last_checked, notes. best_for and skill_level are judgments. skill_level is beginner, intermediate, or advanced.

files.title: Glossary
files.description: Plain-language definitions of common 3D printing words.
files.schema_notes: schema_version, updated, disclaimer, terms[]. Each term has id, term, and definition.

files.title: Materials
files.description: Beginner and advanced filament ranges. The spool label still wins.
files.schema_notes: schema_version, updated, disclaimer, sources[], materials[]. Each material has id, name, level (beginner or advanced), nozzle_c {min,max}, bed_c {min,max}, enclosure (no, optional, or yes), chamber_note, dry_c {min,max}, dry_hours, good_for, watch_outs, source_url.

files.title: Troubleshooting
files.description: Print defects with symptom, ordered causes, fixes, and difficulty.
files.schema_notes: schema_version, updated, disclaimer, defects[]. Each defect has id, title, symptom, difficulty (easy, medium, or hard), image, page, causes[] (cause, fix), and source_urls.
